_readme: This file is the reviewed profile of the development environment of the reference estate. Terraform loads it automatically (the suffix of the file is the signal), so a plan of the directory needs no flag of the variable. Every value below is a reviewed value of the reference sandbox, not a credential and not a secret of any account: the account identifiers are the reserved example identifiers of the public documentation, and the two DataDog keys are the placeholders of the reviewer who plans the sandbox of the repository on their own account, who replaces them before any apply. A value that belongs to the estate of a team arrives through a file of variables of their own, which they pass with the flag of the variable on the command line; the precedence of Terraform places such a file above this one.
_datadog_comment: The sandbox of the repository plans the plane of Amazon Web without the plane of the vendor: the resources of DataDog are materialised only when the flag below is true and the runner of the pipeline carries the real credentials of the board in its environment. The two values below are the placeholders of the reviewer of the repository, of at least the twenty-four characters that the validation of the variable demands, so that the plan of the sandbox is complete and the validation of the variables passes; they are not valid credentials and they are never used while the flag is false.
